This Bammi-seṭṭi is said to have burnt Koḍla, Moghakoppaṇi and Dirasamuḍra at Maḻugunda. Miruṇjiya-vīra-bhaṭāra belonged to Sāniyava and Kittagāve arēsiya of the Kālāmukha sect. Pāṇḍya and his brother Vīra-Pāṇḍya were the last of them.
